description:
Create, list, print, copy, delete and render notes in the vault. A note is named by its stem — its filename without `.md`, e.g. `2026-09-10-14-30-00`. Nothing prompts and nothing opens an application.

Subcommands:
  new — create a note from flags and print its path. Requires --type (Meeting, Correspondence, Workshop, Report, Log, Research or Recipe), --topic and at least one --thread (name, Kind/Name or wikilink; repeatable). --person is accepted for Meeting and Correspondence, --counterparty and --location for Meeting only. Drops a REF into the buffer for each thread.
  list [FILTER] — stem, date, type, threads and topic of every note, oldest first by the frontmatter timestamp. --json for structured output. FILTER matches any column, case-insensitively.
  cat STEM — print a note to stdout.
  last — print the path of the newest note.
  copy STEM — copy a note to a new timestamp; every line starting with `topic:` gets ` COPY`.
  delete STEM — permanently delete a note. Requires -y.
  pdf STEM — render the note to markdown and PDF: callouts after `# Summary`, an action table after `# Action Items`.
  minutes STEM — render meeting minutes: agreements, resolutions and an action table.
  agenda STEM — render a meeting agenda: the note with the outcome sections emptied and empty sub-headings dropped.

pdf, minutes and agenda write STEM.md and STEM.md.pdf to ~/Downloads, or to --out DIR, and print both paths. A topic containing a colon or a quote makes the PDF step fail, because it is written into the pandoc metadata unquoted; the markdown is still written.

Every subcommand except `new` ingests pending ACTION: lines into task anchors first.

BLOCKED: delete. These subcommands are refused and calling one returns an error. Do not attempt them.
